description: Explain whether a US family's insurance covers a breast pump: pump types, when to order, Rx rule, next steps, one coverage CTA (paid only for eligible commercial/Marketplace results, and flagged), sources and verification status. Uninsured results list official coverage paths. Any paid referral appears only in the separate sponsored_next_steps array, which is off by default. Don't send personal data.

carrier.description: Optional carrier, for commercial or marketplace: uhc, aetna, cigna, bcbs, kaiser, or a name like 'Anthem'

due_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD. A past date is treated as the baby's birth date.

state.description: 2-letter US state code or name, e.g. TX. DC is supported.

name: check_coverage
title: Check breast pump coverage
